chapters.title: Start with a creator.
chapters.body: Follow a creator whose work you want to see again.

chapters.title: Choose what plays.
chapters.body: Eligible sources can appear in Today. Pick a film when you’re ready.

chapters.title: Keep your place.
chapters.body: Save a film for later. Open Saved to resume where you stopped.

chapters.title: Make a programme.
chapters.body: Add films to a session, choose their order, then start with the first.
